manage.title: Manage
manage.notFoundHint: That Space does not exist, or you cannot reach it.
manage.notYoursHint: {{owner}} owns {{space}}. Only the Owner can change its settings or its Members.

mode.title: Who can publish
mode.blurb: Switching is lossless: it changes only who may publish from now on. Every Lesson keeps its place, its author and everyone's progress.
mode.guidedHint: Only you and your Editors publish Lessons from now on.
mode.openHint: Every Member can publish Lessons from now on.

grounding.title: Source of truth
grounding.blurb: Off by default. Turning it on nominates published Lessons as the reference, and everything else in the Space then shows whether it traces back to them. It never blocks anything — it labels.
grounding.showHint: Mark what traces back to this Space’s material.
grounding.strictHint: Keep the path to material that traces back. Needs grounding on.

orphans.title: Needs a new home
orphans.blurb: The Lesson these were attached to was deleted. They are still here and still count — give each one a Lesson, or leave them and their authors can.

members.title: Members
members.blurb: Editors can add and edit content. Members learn, and can always contribute.
members.removedHint: Their contributions and credit stay in the Space.
members.alone: Only you so far. Share the code below to bring people in.

invite.title: Invite with a code
invite.blurb: Anyone with this joins directly. There is no approval step.

archive.title: Archive
archive.blurb: Archived is read-only. Progress is kept and nothing is lost, but it earns no XP and drops to the bottom of your Spaces.

delete.title: Delete this Space
delete.blurb: Every Lesson, every contribution and everyone’s progress goes with it. This cannot be undone. Type <name>{{space}}</name> to confirm.
delete.confirmLabel: Type the Space name to confirm deletion

cleared.label: Cleared
cleared.blurb: You have answered practice on this correctly.

discovered.label: Read
discovered.blurb: You have met this idea but not yet proved it.

untouched.blurb: You have not reached this idea.
